rationale: C09 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It uses the same section 7 escape-clause machinery and nearly the same recital-to-operative sequence: identify the trade agreement and concession, describe the applied concessionary duty, report a Tariff Commission investigation and serious-injury finding, cite section 350(a)(2), find that modifying the concession and applying higher duties is appropriate, modify the tariff item in paragraph (a), apply the modified rates in paragraph (b), and modify the earlier proclamation accordingly. C19 and C25 embody the same machinery and contain substantial parallel language, but C09 is temporally closest and most closely matches the child's formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the United States Tariff Commission has submitted to me its report of an investigation, including a hearing, under section 7 ... [and] found that certain products ... are ... being imported ... in such increased quantities ... as to cause serious injury to the domestic industries producing like or directly competitive products
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the United States Tariff Commission has submitted to me its report of an investigation, including a hearing, under section 7 ... [and] found that alsike clover seed ... is ... being imported ... in such increased quantities as to cause serious injury to the domestic industry producing like or directly competitive products
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel statement of the statutory investigation, causal role of the concession, increased imports, and serious injury.

shared_material.child_excerpt: section 350 (a) (2) ... authorizes the President to proclaim such modifications of existing duties as are required or appropriate to carry out any foreign trade agreement
shared_material.parent_excerpt: section 350 (a) (2) ... authorizes the President to proclaim such modification of existing duties and such additional import restrictions as are required or appropriate to carry out any foreign trade agreement
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical legal-authority recital supporting the same operative mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: (a) That the provisions of item 367 (a) ... shall be modified ... so as to read as follows: (b) That ... the rates of duty specified in such modified item 367 (a) as set forth in paragraph (a) above shall be applied
shared_material.parent_excerpt: (a) That the provision in the said item 763 ... shall be modified ... to read as follows: (b) That ... alsike clover seed described in the said item 763 as modified by paragraph (a) above, shall be subject to the rates of duty specified in such modified item 763
shared_material.explanation: The operative provisions share the same two-step structure: rewrite a specified tariff item, then direct application of the rates in that modified item.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The said proclamation of January 9, 1936, as supplemented, is modified accordingly.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Proclamation No. 2761A of December 16, 1947, as amended and supplemented, is modified accordingly
shared_material.explanation: Matching concluding clause updates the earlier implementing proclamation to reflect the tariff-item modification.
